title: Hybrid SPR joints in fatigue
heading: One structural stress for lap-shear and coach-peel joints
label: Fatigue lives of %n self-piercing-riveted aluminium–steel joints against %v; the ±2s scatter band spans a factor of %b.
caption: Each point is one fatigue test at R = 0.1 on an aluminium–steel joint. Plotted against the applied force, lap-shear and coach-peel joints fall on different curves. The Rupp-type structural stress at the rivet, from calibrated finite element models, brings all thickness combinations and both geometries onto one S–N curve. Switch views to compare.
provenance: Static and fatigue tests by A. Chiocca on Al 5005 / Fe P05 joints with and without Terokal 4497 adhesive, within a PRIN project; manuscript in preparation. The structural stress, its weights and the S–N curves are the outputs of the article's assessment scripts.
